# Linear — Linear for startups

Free access to Linear's Business plan for startups affiliated with an official Linear partner; valid only for non-paying Linear users with fewer than 50 employees, redeemed through a partner link or code.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Status** | Open, but needs an accelerator, VC or partner code |
| **Verification** | Verified — A human opened the official page and confirmed this claim. |
| **Last verified** | 2026-09-14 by [@tayyabakmal1](https://github.com/tayyabakmal1) |
| **Category** | [📋 Productivity & Ops](../categories/productivity.md) |


## What you get

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | free plan |
| **Amount** | The vendor publishes no figure |
| **When it ends** | When your free period ends, your workspace moves to Linear's free plan unless you choose to upgrade. You keep all of your data and can pick a paid plan at any time. |


### Not covered

- Paying Linear users
- Companies with 50 or more employees
- Startups with no official Linear partner affiliation

> **Stacking:** To redeem you must be an admin of your Linear workspace and logged in; follow the partner's redemption link or enter the partner code when prompted.

### Where it is available

**The vendor publishes no geographic restriction.** That is not the same as
confirming it is available where you are — check their terms before applying.

### Notes

Linear does NOT state the length of the free period anywhere on the page - it refers only to "your free period" - so duration_months is left null. The employee cap is worded "less than 50 employees" / "fewer than 50 employees", recorded here as employees_max 50. Partners include venture capital firms, startup accelerators and startup communities (455 listed, including non-VC entities such as Stripe Atlas, Mercury, Brex, Clerky and Ramp), so partner affiliation does not necessarily mean VC backing.
